facts.fact: 从饭桌逃出后她在街头发抖，只想找个人说话
facts.anchor: She texts Charlie: Hey, are you free? Can we Skype?

facts.fact: 她连网吧地址都说不清，只报了个街区
facts.anchor: She doesn’t know the address of Cookies so just tells the driver to go to Ménilmontant.

facts.fact: 买日卡时她进入上台表演般的出体状态

facts.fact: 她讲父亲生前最后说起母亲放弃的艺术生活
facts.anchor: She talks about the last time she saw her dad, how he was talking about how her mom used to have an artistic life

facts.fact: Charlie 说错过最初四个月不算什么

facts.fact: Charlie 用自己的父亲作比，说缺席不等于不是父亲
facts.anchor: My dad missed the last seventeen years, but he’s still my dad.

facts.fact: Max 已经开始和别人约会
结尾问句：对不同的人做不同的人
facts.anchor: How did I get to a point where I need to be a completely different person with the different people in my life?
